# Freckle MCP server

> Freckle's hosted MCP server lets AI agents build company and people lists, enrich leads, author and run Workflows, import HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio and Snowflake records, monitor Signals and sync Ads audiences in a Freckle Workspace. URL: https://next-api.freckle.io/mcp/full (Streamable HTTP, OAuth).

## Docs

- [Freckle MCP server](mcp.md): setup for Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and other clients; example prompts; credits and safety; data and privacy; the full tool reference; troubleshooting
- [Tool reference (JSON)](tools.json): every tool's name, title and credit effect
